# @three-ws/agent

> Run a three.ws agent on your own machine or VPS: a terminal UI with slash commands, streaming tool output, local file and shell tools in a resource-limited sandbox, the three.ws MCP tools and agent wallet, SQLite sessions with full-text search, parallel subagents, natural-language cron, and a Telegram gateway.

@three-ws/agent is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/agent`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-agent/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-agent/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-agent/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-agent/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
